class Solution:
    def reorderList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> None:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return

        slow = head
        fast = head
        while fast.next and fast.next.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next

        second = slow.next
        slow.next = None

        prev = None
        while second:
            nxt = second.next
            second.next = prev
            prev = second
            second = nxt

        first = head
        second = prev
        while second:
            fnext = first.next
            snext = second.next
            first.next = second
            second.next = fnext
            first = fnext
            second = snext
